rdfs:label: Logo
rdfs:comment: Deprecated. Intended as a vCard Logo class, but the W3C vCard ontology defines no Logo class — only the hasLogo property.
notes: Deprecated: there is no `vcard:Logo` class in the W3C vCard ontology (http://www.w3.org/2006/vcard/ns), so this term has no upstream equivalent. Use `urn:solid:hasLogo` with the logo image IRI as its value (schema.org data: `schema:logo`). For structured image metadata, describe the image as a `urn:solid:Image` or `urn:solid:ImageObject`.
